stageNote: Authored at spec level before scopes.md and test-plan.json exist. scopeId values name the intended scope decomposition recorded in spec.md and are subject to change when bubbles.plan authors the scopes. linkedTests, testRows and evidenceRefs are deliberately empty because no test plan has been authored; populating them now would be a fabricated linkage.
businessScenarioMapping: SCN-019-001 through SCN-019-020 map one-to-one onto BS-019-001 through BS-019-020 in spec.md.

scenarios.title: A disposable clone sees every declared topic

gherkin.given: the agenda registry is a committed repository file and the scheduler has cloned origin/main into a disposable checkout
gherkin.then: it sees every topic the operator declared on the branch and reads no browser state and no uncommitted local file

scenarios.title: An absent agenda is a named absence

gherkin.given: no agenda registry exists in the checkout
gherkin.then: it records a named absence with a reason, does not synthesise a default topic set, and the rest of the brief still generates

scenarios.title: One invalid topic does not disable the others

gherkin.given: the agenda declares three topics and one is missing its declared question
gherkin.then: the invalid topic is refused with a named reason and the remaining two topics are still reviewed

scenarios.title: A newly declared topic enters the review cycle

gherkin.given: the operator commits a new topic with a declared question and a cadence
gherkin.then: the topic is treated as due because it has never been reviewed, and a first dossier is produced or a named outcome is recorded

scenarios.title: Pausing suspends review and preserves history

gherkin.given: a topic whose lifecycle state is paused
gherkin.then: the topic is not researched, its dossier history remains readable, and the published record states paused rather than unavailable

scenarios.title: Retirement is append-only

gherkin.given: the operator retires a topic
gherkin.then: the topic is not researched, no prior dossier version is deleted or rewritten, and the retirement is recorded as a new lifecycle event

scenarios.title: The operator's actual research history is expressible

gherkin.given: the operator declares a defense production and earnings-acceleration topic, a U.S.-Iran oil and Strait of Hormuz topic, and a food, grains and fertilizer topic
gherkin.then: all three are accepted with their own declared questions, scope boundaries and cadences

scenarios.title: Cadence prevents pointless work

gherkin.given: a topic reviewed one generation ago with a weekly cadence and no material-change trigger fired
gherkin.then: the topic is not due, its most recent dossier remains current, and the published outcome is unchanged rather than updated

scenarios.title: Time makes a topic due

gherkin.given: a topic whose declared cadence has elapsed since its last review
gherkin.then: the topic is due and is queued for research this generation

scenarios.title: A material change overrides the cadence

gherkin.given: a topic declaring a material-change trigger whose condition is observable in this generation's committed evidence
gherkin.then: the topic is due even though its cadence has not elapsed, and the published record names the trigger

scenarios.title: More due topics than the budget allows

gherkin.given: more topics are due than the declared per-generation review budget
gherkin.when: the generation selects topics to research
gherkin.then: it researches up to the budget in a declared deterministic order and every deferred topic publishes a named deferred outcome with its reason

scenarios.title: A dossier carries provenance

gherkin.given: a due topic researched successfully this generation
gherkin.then: every finding carries an observation date, a source and a stated confidence, the dossier carries the generation instant and topic identifier, and the outcome state is updated

scenarios.title: No new evidence is a real answer

gherkin.given: a due topic whose research surfaced no new evidence since its last dossier
gherkin.then: the outcome state is unchanged, no new finding is invented, and the prior dossier remains current

scenarios.title: Old evidence is labelled, never presented as current

gherkin.given: a due topic whose newest available evidence predates its declared freshness window
gherkin.then: the outcome state is stale, the record names the age of the newest evidence, and the findings are not presented as a current read

scenarios.title: A failed lane is a named absence

gherkin.given: a due topic whose research lane failed or returned nothing usable
gherkin.then: the outcome state is unavailable with a named reason, no partial or inferred finding is published, and the remaining topics are unaffected

scenarios.title: History is append-only

gherkin.given: a topic with an existing dossier
gherkin.when: a new review produces an updated dossier
gherkin.then: the new version references the version it supersedes, the superseded version is still readable, and no prior finding is edited in place

scenarios.title: A refinement narrows, it does not replace

gherkin.given: a topic whose declared question admits a narrower sub-question the evidence now supports
gherkin.then: the refinement is recorded as a dated attributed addition inside the declared question and the operator's declared question text is unchanged

scenarios.title: A refinement outside the boundary is refused

gherkin.given: a proposed refinement whose subject falls outside the topic's declared scope boundary
gherkin.then: it is refused with a named reason and the topic's declared question and scope boundary are unchanged

scenarios.title: Public scope only

gherkin.given: any dossier produced by this feature
gherkin.then: it contains no position, size, cost basis or profit-or-loss figure and every subject it names is a public market object or public ticker

scenarios.title: A read that does not reach the brief does not ship

gherkin.given: a generation in which at least one topic was reviewed
gherkin.when: the published payload and the brief page artifact are inspected
gherkin.then: the payload carries a research read for the agenda under its registered tool id with each topic's outcome state, the brief page artifact carries the agenda material the reader-facing section renders, and the read is visible on a brief surface the reader opens rather than only present in the payload or confined to a dossier file
